12/ Viral Potential & Branding

The $DOG brand is clean, simple, and memorable.

$DOG simplifies $DOGE: drop the “e” for a cleaner, stronger brand and with strong backing from creators such as @LeonidasNFT and @tahaabbasi this coin can go places!

10/ Historical Memecoin Trajectory

Let’s look at $DOGE and $SHIBA:

$DOGE hit $70B market cap at its peak.
$SHIBA reached $43B market cap, starting from almost nothing.

$DOG has all the elements of these meme coin giants but is built on Bitcoin.

8/ Fixed Supply Like Bitcoin

$DOG has a fixed supply of 100 billion tokens, similar to Bitcoin’s hard cap.

Unlike $DOGE, which is inflationary and adds 5B tokens annually, $DOG's supply is locked—making it a better store of value in the long run.

6/ Community-Driven Powerhouse

$DOG’s strength lies in its community. The $DOG Army is relentless:

$DOG has more engagement per $1M market cap than $DOGE or $SHIBA.

Binance, Kraken and other exchanges have seen $DOG posts outperform major altcoins by engagement.
